observations: A20 enable failure leaves AX zero and calls an indirect far pointer at DOSDATA offset 0x133a.
Other target kernel call sites use the same pointer with AX values 1, 2 and 3.
The BIOS error entry at file 0xac2 branches on AX nonzero: AX zero takes the A20 video-print-and-halt path; nonzero proceeds through the BIOS error vector.
The BIOS message routine at 0x2345 recognizes selectors 1, 2 and 3.
inference: The shared selector conventions strongly suggest DOSDATA:133a is connected to the BIOS error entry. The actual pointer initialization has not been proven, so this is not yet a verified direct link.
limitations: No actual target far-pointer value or initialization store has been verified.
Potential intervening handlers or transformations cannot yet be excluded.
Full DOS/BIOS link and error path are not verified.
